body.x: Forest Walk, as per the age of students and batch size.

It is an irony that despite being one of the greenest capitals, New Delhi has recently been declared the most polluted city in the world. Forest Walks are an opportunity for students to explore the green patches and major forests in the city such as Sanjay Van, Okhla bird sanctuary and Asola Bhati wildlife sanctuary. These walks intend to instill a sense of responsibility in the students and make them aware of the dangers of the fast vanishing urban forest cover. Lead by experts, these trips are a great platform to get familiar with local flora and fauna. These walks can be facilitated in a similar manner across any urban area.
